requirements.requirement: Operator must establish authorized service use and project access conditions; a particular account or analytical use is not authorized by this review.
Provider copyright banner belongs near displayed data; required attribution and service link also belong in help. Renderer/placement acceptance belongs to frontend/backend.

Only temporary caching within authorized service functionality is the stated exception to saving/processing/modification restrictions. Private immutable cache episodes expire; permanent dataset publication is not authorized by this implementation.
Provider restrictions may change. Operator records current authorization and selected cache expiry; no fixed TTL or day-reset timezone is inferred.

requirements.requirement: Bind station/date/offset/limit and UTC dated events to each captured page. Thread UID identifies a thread; a physical execution needs separate reviewed identity. Pagination completeness is not network completeness.
GET /v3.0/copyright/ accepts Authorization header and format=json. Every fresh API attempt consumes the same quota as search; reuse only a still-authorized cached copyright capture.
